Shard queue

For the storage term, see Shard (database).
Shard queue
TypeDistributed work queue
First described2019
Claim modelTime-bounded lease

A shard queue distributes units of work to workers that claim them one at a time. Unlike a static partition, the queue allows a fast worker to take more work than a slow one.

History

The design appeared in web crawlers, where a single slow host could otherwise hold up the whole run. Later systems adopted the same claim protocol for batch processing.

Design

A claim is written with an expiry. A worker that stops renewing loses the shard, and the shard returns to the queue for another worker to claim.

References

  1. Example Systems Group. Claim protocols for crawlers. 2021.
  2. Another Author. Lease expiry without a coordinator. 2023.
